## Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan (Jek) {-}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width=50%}
![](include/img/pesigan-ivan-jek.jpg){width=200px height=200px}
:::
::: {.column width=50%}
[Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan (Jek), Ph.D.](https://quantdev.ssri.psu.edu/people/ibp5092) is an Assistant Research Professor in the Quantitative Developmental Systems Methodology Core (QuantDev) in the [Social Science Research Institute](https://ssri.psu.edu) at Penn State.

[Jek](https://quantdev.ssri.psu.edu/people/ibp5092) specializes in quantitative methodology, statistical modeling, and computational research, with a focus on developing statistical methods and software for analyzing longitudinal data. An advocate for open science and computational reproducibility, his interests extend to research software development, containerization, and high-performance computing. His work bridges statistical methodology and reproducible computational practices to advance transparent, accessible, and reliable scientific research.
:::
::::
